_comment: Guided tour of the onboarding wizard. Targets are controls of the emtk app: the step list ('nav_list'), the Back/Next/Finish and page buttons (their action names) and the embedded editors ('detector_save', 'fcs_Save').

steps.title: The steps
steps.text: Every step of the setup is listed here. A check mark means the step needs nothing more from you. Click a step to go there; nothing has to be done in order.

await.hint: Click any step in the list.

steps.title: Go on with Next
steps.text: Next and Back only move between steps; they never change your settings.

steps.title: Create what is missing
steps.text: Open Fix / Initialize if the Settings step lists a file as MISSING. Create missing files writes only the files that do not exist yet; Restore defaults replaces your settings and asks first.

await.hint: Go to the Fix / Initialize step and press Create missing files.

steps.title: New fitting models
steps.text: Update experiments copies the packaged model list over yours so new models show up in the add-fit list. Restart ChiSurf afterwards.

await.hint: Go to the Experiments step and press Update experiments.

steps.title: Describe your detectors
steps.text: The Detector setup step hosts the channel-definition editor. Set up the routing channels and PIE windows once for your hardware and press Save; the step then gets its check mark.

steps.title: FCS channel pairs
steps.text: For burst-wise FCS, pick the detector setup, add a channel pair and press Save.

steps.title: Done
steps.text: Finish closes the wizard. You can run it again from the Plugin Manager whenever something is missing.

await.hint: Go to the last step and press Finish.
